evidence_requests.question: Screen the current partition for unsupported internal splits and weak pair boundaries.

observations.meaning: Algorithmic eigengap screening resolution for each candidate set; candidate_k=1 indicates the dominant spectral gap is at the single-cluster resolution.
observations.finding: All five candidate sets (K5_C0001 through K5_C0005) screen at candidate_k=1, so the partition-level screen shows no dominant multi-cluster subdivision signal for any candidate.

observations.meaning: Magnitude of the leading spectral gap at the screened resolution for each candidate set.
observations.finding: Leading gaps are largest for K5_C0001 and K5_C0002 (~0.24 and ~0.23), intermediate for K5_C0003 and K5_C0004 (~0.14 and ~0.12), and smallest for K5_C0005 (~0.036); these describe dominance of the single-cluster resolution rather than internal multi-cluster substructure.

observations.meaning: Profile of spectral eigengaps across candidate resolutions within each set.
observations.finding: For every set the first gap is far larger than all subsequent gaps, and secondary gaps are small (all below ~0.0022), consistent with a single dominant resolution and no prominent secondary subdivision signal at this screening level.

observations.meaning: Average fused affinity among patients assigned to the same candidate set.
observations.finding: Within-set mean affinities are similar across sets (~0.0095 to ~0.0105), with the smallest set K5_C0005 (n=4) showing the highest within-set affinity and the larger sets slightly lower values.

observations.meaning: Number of patients represented in each structural calculation.
observations.finding: Set sizes range from 4 to 35 patients; the structural screen is based on these represented memberships.

observations.meaning: Relatively close candidate pairs and their average fused affinity across the current pair boundary; a pair-review entry point, not a merge conclusion.
observations.finding: The closest boundaries are K5_C0003–K5_C0005 (~0.00922) and K5_C0001–K5_C0005 (~0.00913), followed by K5_C0002–K5_C0003, K5_C0001–K5_C0002, K5_C0001–K5_C0004, and K5_C0002–K5_C0004 (all ~0.00903–0.00906); these between-set affinities are close to the within-set means, indicating weak separation at these boundaries.

evidence_reports.dimension_interpretation: Partition-level structural diagnostics are triage evidence about whether current membership or boundaries are represented in the fused patient geometry. The internal screen shows candidate_k=1 for every set, with a dominant leading eigengap and only small secondary gaps, so this screening calculation does not show a dominant multi-cluster subdivision signal for any candidate. Nearest-pair affinities identify relatively close boundaries (notably K5_C0003–K5_C0005 and K5_C0001–K5_C0005) whose between-set affinities are close to within-set affinities, indicating weak pair separation at those boundaries. These results do not by themselves establish retention, split, or merge, and no reclustering was performed.
evidence_reports.cross_evidence_context: No prior Evidence Reports were supplied for this round, so this interpretation stands alone without prior-report agreement or conflict to integrate.
limitations: Partition-level screening does not provide actual feasible k>=2 internal solutions or their measurements; absence of a subdivision signal here is not evidence about independence from neighboring candidates.
Weak pair separation does not recommend merge, and the nearest-pair list is a review entry point rather than a merge conclusion.

actions.reason: K5_C0001 has an interpretable biological identity (coordinated OXPHOS/metabolic down-shift with TGF-beta/WNT up-shift), but identity alone does not establish independent membership. Set-level geometry shows near-zero silhouettes and near-equal within- versus between-set distances in all four modalities, providing little support that this membership is separately represented. The pair-level fused-geometry boundary with K5_C0005 is essentially null (boundary silhouette ~0.0004; between-set affinity 0.00913 vs within-set 0.00947), and the union is single-cluster dominated, so the closest boundary is not expressed. With membership independence unsupported and no warranted structural revision, K5_C0001 is not retained.

K5_C0002 shows a coherent biological identity (up-enriched OXPHOS, protein secretion, fatty-acid metabolism, adipogenesis, mTORC1 with down-enriched myogenesis/immune programs). Set-level geometry provides modest positive membership representation: within-set distances are smaller than between-set distances in all four modalities, with the clearest separation in WXS (silhouette 0.173) and consistent direction in CT, WSI, and RNA. This positive, directionally consistent membership evidence supports continued treatment as an independent unit.

K5_C0003 shows a coherent immune-activation biological identity (up-enriched allograft rejection, interferon alpha/gamma, IL6/JAK/STAT3, inflammatory programs with down-enriched metabolic/developmental programs). Set-level geometry shows the most consistent membership representation among the sets: positive silhouettes in all four modalities and smaller within-set than between-set distances in every modality. The pair-level fused-geometry boundary with K5_C0005 is null, but that concerns the specific K5_C0003-K5_C0005 boundary rather than K5_C0003's own membership representation, which is positively supported. Retained as an independent unit.

K5_C0004 has an interpretable stromal/EMT biological identity (up-enriched EMT, Hedgehog, angiogenesis, mitotic spindle with down-enriched OXPHOS and immune programs), but identity alone does not establish independent membership. Set-level geometry shows near-zero or negative silhouettes in CT, WSI, and RNA (only WXS modestly positive at 0.073) and within-set distances equal to or larger than between-set distances in CT, WSI, and WXS, providing little support that this membership is separately represented. With membership independence unsupported and no warranted structural revision, K5_C0004 is not retained.

K5_C0005 has an interpretable proliferation biological identity (up-enriched E2F/MYC/G2M/mTORC1 with down-enriched immune programs), but identity alone does not establish independent membership. Set-level geometry shows a separation signal confined to WSI (silhouette 0.268) with near-zero or reversed separation in CT, RNA, and WXS, and the set has only 4 members, so membership representation is limited and modality-inconsistent. Both pair-level fused-geometry boundaries involving K5_C0005 (with K5_C0001 and with K5_C0003) are essentially null (boundary silhouettes ~0.0004 and ~0.0007) with single-cluster-dominated unions, so neither boundary is expressed. With membership independence unsupported and no warranted structural revision, K5_C0005 is not retained.
